Vidya Gupta | vidya.gupta800@example.com | +91 9689018944
Whitefield, Bangalore

Professional Summary
DevOps and cloud-focused engineer with cross-functional experience spanning platform automation, CI/CD pipelines, and financial planning support for product teams. Skilled at designing infrastructure-as-code and production-grade Kubernetes platforms while collaborating with finance and engineering stakeholders. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, CICD, Jenkins, Linux, GitHub Actions, Financial Modelling, FP&A, Confluence, Agile

Work Experience

DevOps Engineer, Zoho (Mar 2024 - Present)
- Implemented Terraform modules to standardize VPC, networking and EKS cluster provisioning, reducing cluster setup time by 60% using Terraform.
- Automated application deployments to Kubernetes with GitHub Actions and Helm charts, achieving >95% successful deployment rate and shortening release cycles.
- Hardened Linux-based node images and operational runbooks in Confluence, improving mean time to recovery for node issues by 40%.

Cloud Engineer, Zentrix Labs (Aug 2022 - Feb 2024)
- Built and maintained Terraform infrastructure for multi-environment workloads, enabling repeatable environment creation for staging and production.
- Containerized microservices using Docker and integrated with Jenkins pipelines to streamline CICD, cutting manual release steps by half.
- Implemented CI/CD best practices and Jenkins job templates, improving deployment consistency across teams and reducing rollback incidents.

FP&A Manager, Orbit Health (Jun 2019 - Jul 2022)
- Led financial modelling and FP&A processes for product lines, creating scenario models that informed quarterly budgeting and resource allocation.
- Partnered with engineering and product teams using Confluence and Agile rituals to align financial forecasts with delivery roadmaps.
- Developed monthly variance analysis reports and dashboards that reduced forecasting error and improved decision-making cadence.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
